breakdown.description: Boundary section contains incompatible boundary condition types (e.g., periodic vs Dirichlet/Neumann).
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt contained contradictory boundary conditions: Dirichlet on all four edges and periodic conditions. The ground truth resolved this by removing the periodic condition. The generated specification correctly omits any mention of periodic boundary conditions and only includes the instruction to 'Apply Dirichlet boundary conditions on all four edges', thus resolving the inconsistency in line with the ground truth.
